hypothesis: Per-phase object-contact evidence can identify lost grasp before a downstream IK exception, avoiding misdirected planning repair
changed_factor: Observation/diagnosis tool; no task-success or control changes
algorithm: During transport/align, detect3 consecutive samples without finger-plug contact and object-gripper distance > end-of-lift distance+10mm. Report earliest observed event; exclude release/retreat.
acceptance: Localize development loss before align exception with measured contact/separation evidence
No loss alarms on six untouched complete-success episodes; report all UNKNOWN cases rather than counting them as correct
Include actual collection entry integration and source hashes; do not claim old agent_loop is changed
limitations: Only one observed positive, used for development; no independent positive recall validation
A valid successful Episode is a negative control for catastrophic carry loss, not a proof of no microslip
Threshold and sampling do not identify exact physical onset or friction root cause
No task success, cost or deployment safety improvement inferred from diagnosis accuracy
